item: Typical miss of the best guess, before the open
result: High ₹43, low ₹48 (half the time within ₹34 / ₹32); 'price stays' would miss by ₹63 / ₹61
caveat: Out of sample; independent check reproduced it from the raw files

item: Typical miss once the official open is known (09:08)
result: High ₹35, low ₹37; pinball loss 23% lower than before the open (Holm p < 0.001)
sample: 320 sessions; 52 since the closing auction (same direction)
caveat: The gain comes from the open's level, not from the gap's size or sign (those added nothing, Holm p >= 0.48)

result: 90% bands held 90.3% (high) and 88.8% (low); the after-open high band is really a 19-in-20 band (the open is the high on about 4% of days)
caveat: Wording fixed after the independent check

result: 50% bands held only about 40% of the time; the real high fell below its own 5% line on 15% of days (8 of 52)
caveat: Small sample, suggestive; the high is the shakier of the two numbers

item: Any extra variable (gap, weekday, range model, Garman-Klass)
result: None beat the project baseline; the volatility model helps the high against raw history, ties for the low
caveat: Gain is in the band shape, not the best guess

item: Live running high and low: do the printed bands hold?
result: Final high / low 'half the time' bands held 54% / 57%; 'nine times in ten' held 88% / 88%
caveat: Real uncertainty is about +-16 points on a 50% cell; the tool ignores the official open, so the high floor can be a few rupees low

result: Conservative: stated 62% was followed by 81% (15-minute data) and 61% by 72% (hourly)
caveat: Fails in the 90-100% bin (stated 97.5%, observed 91.3%, two sessions)

item: The live tool's 'another Rs X-Y is typical' line and 'chance of at least Rs 5/10/20/40'
result: The typical-extension line contained the real extension only 33-36% of the time (intended 50%); the chance of a given extension runs 4-9 points too high
caveat: Do not rely on these two lines

item: Yahoo against the NSE official high and low
result: Official high above Yahoo's by ₹0.2 typically (mean 0.9, 95th percentile 4.0); official low below by ₹0.7 (mean 1.1, 95th percentile 3.9)
caveat: A few rupees either way; on gap-open days the official open can sit outside every Yahoo bar

item: Trade a limit buy at the estimated low, exit at the close
result: Lost ₹14 a share net of a 0.10% round-trip cost (85 fills of 320)
caveat: The level is reached as often as promised (26.6%) but the price does not turn there

item: Trade a limit sell at the estimated high, exit at the close
result: Lost ₹9.9 a share net of cost (78 fills of 320)
caveat: Same: reached 24.4% of days against 25% promised

item: Follow a break of the first-hour range to the close
result: +0.47% a trade in one six-month window, +0.04% after, -0.14% since the closing auction
caveat: Looks like an edge in one window, then fades; not usable
